title: $L^q$-norm bounds for arithmetic eigenfunctions via microlocal Kakeya-Nikodym estimate
summary: Let $X$ be a compact arithmetic congruence hyperbolic surface, and let $ψ$ be an $L^2$-normalized Hecke-Maass form on $X$ with sufficiently large spectral parameter $λ$. We give a new proof to obtain a power saving for the global $L^6$-norm $\|ψ\|_{L^6(X)}\lesssim_\varepsilonλ^{\frac{5}{36}+\varepsilon}$ over the local bound $\|ψ\|_{L^6(X)}\lesssimλ^{\frac{1}{6}}$ of Sogge. Our method uses a microlocal decomposition for $ψ$ and reduces the $L^6$-norm problem to microlocal Kakeya-Nikodym estimates for $ψ$, and we establish improved microlocal Kakeya-Nikodym estimates via arithmetic…
